Discover the quiet truth behind history’s greatest financial empires, the rise and fall of currencies, and the economic disasters that shaped our world.

Here, we tell the stories that history books often bury in footnotes:
→ How mighty empires went bankrupt
→ How currencies collapsed overnight
→ The secret economic wars that shaped nations
→ And what these patterns mean for today

Calm, deep, research-driven documentary videos every week. Subscribe and turn on notifications so you never miss a story.

History doesn’t repeat, but it rhymes. Welcome to OLD MONEY STORIES.

snippet.title: Extra History
snippet.description:
Welcome! 

We’re an educational YouTube channel made up of entertainment enthusiasts with backgrounds in game design, television production, literature and academia. Our team creates animated video essays about world history, mythology, and other subjects, all of which may or may not involve a cat!

EXTRA HISTORY
History is the best novel you've ever read. Join us Saturdays as we explore dramatic adventures in world history! 

EXTRA MYTHOLOGY
Our myths define us. They are the basis of our culture. Join us every other Wednesday as we delve into some of the coolest stories of world mythology!

SO YOU HAVEN'T READ
Books take us to places we've never been and inspire our imagination. Join us every other Wednesday as we delve into some of the most courageous tales written throughout time!

Check us out on Twitch at: https://www.twitch.tv/extracredits

Check out our sister channel Extra Credits (gaming) here: https://www.youtube.com/@extracredits

snippet.title: History Revealed
snippet.description:
SUBSCRIBE THIS CHANNEL!
Welcome to [ History Revealed ], where history comes alive!

Dive into the past as we explore the fascinating stories, events, and people that have shaped our world. From ancient civilizations to modern history, our channel offers in-depth videos, historical analyses, and thought-provoking discussions on key moments that defined our societies. Whether you're a history buff or simply curious about how the world came to be, we’ve got something for you.

Join us as we uncover hidden stories, challenge historical myths, and bring history to life through engaging storytelling, visuals, and facts. Subscribe and journey through time with us!

snippet.title: Amanpour and Company
snippet.description:
Amanpour and Company is a late-night public affairs series featuring wide-ranging, in-depth conversations with global thought leaders and cultural influencers on the issues and trends impacting the world each day. Christiane Amanpour leads the conversation with other interviews from prominent journalists Walter Isaacson, Michel Martin and Hari Sreenivasan.

Major support for Amanpour and Company is provided by the Anderson Family Endowment, Jim Attwood and Leslie Williams, Candace King Weir, the Sylvia A. and Simon B. Poyta Programming Endowment to Fight Antisemitism, the Straus Family Foundation, The Peter G. Peterson & Joan Ganz Cooney Fund, Charles Rosenblum, Monique Schoen Warshaw, Koo and Patricia Yuen and Barbara Hope Zuckerberg. 

Support programs like Amanpour and Company by donating to your local PBS station:  http://www.pbs.org/donate

snippet.title: Daily Dose Documentary
snippet.description:
Daily Dose Documentary satiates your thirst for historical understanding, life-long learning and a clear conveyance of the truth. It's the decades-long passion project of lead documentary filmmaker, voice actor and author Tom Page. Tom has produced over 1,200 short and long documentaries overwhelmingly about American History, Military History, Biography, and World History. 

Tom has also authored numerous books, including three on under-told stories of American History (Learn more below).

Thank you for watching and learning from history!

snippet.title: Finance Historian
snippet.description:
Money has always ruled the world and its history is full of power, greed, and hidden lessons. 

Finance Historian uncovers the untold stories of wealth, banking, taxation, and economic empires. From ancient coins to modern capitalism, we explore how money shaped nations, changed lives, and still drives the world today.
